The primary value of the film is not its shine, but the preserved factory paint. Repainted panels can be detected by any thickness gauge, and during a pre-purchase inspection, that's an immediate price deduction. The film absorbs impacts instead of the clear coat: minor scratches self-heal in the sun, while deeper ones remain on the film, not on the body.

We cut a template specifically for your vehicle using a plotter and handle complex areas (bumpers, mirrors, pillars) manually. Where the panel allows, we wrap the edge inside: this way, the seam doesn't collect dirt and won't show a thin gray line after a year.

We source our films from XPEL and SunTek. We'll identify the best fit for your car during the inspection before you approve the estimate.

Polishing removes a thin layer of clear coat along with imperfections. The layer is not infinite, so we start with a thickness gauge: measuring each panel to assess how much clear coat remains. If the roof or fenders have a thin clear coat, we proceed cautiously or avoid that panel altogether.

Next, we perform two or three passes: a cutting compound removes the major defects, and a finishing polish eliminates holograms from the machine. We evaluate the result under a light that reveals details not visible outdoors. Only after that do we degrease and apply the ceramic coating. We use Koch-Chemie polishes and apply Gtechniq ceramic coating.

src/content/works/bmw-x5/index.md.b4ef267d9bd2d835:
Another BMW X5 wrapped in clear **PPF**. The film protects the paint from what would normally hit it: gravel, sand, bug splatter, and minor scratches accumulated during everyday driving. We highly recommend protecting the headlights as well. Here’s what it offers up front:
  • stones and road debris won’t reach the glass
  • no scratches or sandblasting
  • ultraviolet rays are blocked by the film, preventing the plastic from yellowing and clouding over time
  • expensive LED and adaptive optics maintain their factory appearance
The rear is simpler:
  • no scratches or minor damage
  • taillights stay clear and shiny longer
Headlights are one of the most vulnerable parts of a car. Year after year, stones, sand, dust, car wash brushes, and sunlight wear away at the optical surface. The film provides an extra layer between them and the plastic, absorbing most of the impact. You can wrap the entire car, just the front end, specific body parts, or only the optics.
src/content/works/bmw-x5/index.md.d773f11cc4a9febe:
Još jedan BMW X5 pod prozirnom **PPF folijom**. Folija preuzima ono što bi inače oštetilo lak: kamenčići, pesak, tragovi insekata i sitne ogrebotine koje auto dobija tokom svakodnevne vožnje. Preporučujemo da posebno zaštitite farove. Šta to donosi sa prednje strane:
  • kamenčići i saobraćajni otpad ne dolaze do stakla
  • nema ogrebotina i peskarenja
  • ultraviolentne zrake se zadržavaju folijom, plastika duže ne žuti i ne mutni
  • skupa LED i adaptivna optika zadržava fabrički izgled
Pozadi je zadatak jednostavniji:
  • nema ogrebotina i sitnih oštećenja
  • lampice duže ostaju prozirne i sjajne
Farovi su jedno od najugroženijih mesta na autu. Kamenčići, pesak, prašina, četke na pranju i sunce, iz godine u godinu, oštećuju površinu optike. Folija postavlja dodatni sloj između njih i plastike, i preuzima većinu udarca na sebe. Možete zaštititi celu mašinu, samo prednji deo, pojedine delove karoserije ili samo optiku.

src/content/works/mersedes-benz-gls/inde.185a358979515594:
Novi Mercedes-Benz GLS 2026 stigao je kod nas sa dva zadatka: zaštita karoserije i promjena izgleda na satinski. Zajedno sa vlasnikom smo odabrali zaštitnu satinsku foliju debljine **190 mikrona**, oblažemo celu karoseriju. Ispod folije fabrički lak ostaje netaknut: male ogrebotine, kamenčići, tragovi insekata, hemikalije i cestovni prljavština više ne dolaze do njega. Satin menja način na koji se automobil čita na svetlu, dok originalna boja ostaje za zaštitnim slojem. Ivice delova savijamo gde je to tehnički moguće: vidljivih ivica je manje, slika je celovitija, a prekrivanje traje duže. Foliju je moguće lokalno popraviti. Ako se tokom korišćenja ošteti jedan deo, obično nije potrebno ponovo oblačiti ceo automobil, folija se menja samo na njemu. Šta donosi potpuno oblaganje:
  • fabrički lak ne skuplja kamenčiće i male ogrebotine
  • cestovna prljavština i hemikalije ostaju na foliji
  • lakše je održavati karoseriju
  • oštećeni element se oblači posebno
  • nova mašina je zaštićena od prvih kilometara
  • očuvan lak koji se vidi prilikom prodaje
  • satinski izgled bez prefarbanja
Oblaganje PPF folijom radimo u Beogradu, na Zvezdari. Obložiti se može i nova mašina, i ona koja je već vozila: potpuno ili samo najranjiviji delovi. Opciju folije ćemo odabrati na pregledu. Rezultat potpunog oblaganja GLS satinskom folijom prikazaćemo kada završimo.
src/content/works/mersedes-benz-gls/inde.702d95e1ce3cc071:
The new 2026 Mercedes-Benz GLS arrived at our studio with two tasks in mind: to protect the body and to change its appearance to a satin finish. Together with the owner, we chose a **190-micron** thick protective satin film to wrap the entire vehicle. Under the film, the factory paint remains untouched: minor scratches, stone chips, insect residue, chemicals, and road dirt are no longer a concern. The satin finish alters the way the car reflects light, while the original color stays protected beneath the layer. We fold the edges of the pieces where technically possible: this reduces visible seams, creates a more cohesive look, and extends the longevity of the covering. The film can be repaired locally. If one part gets damaged during use, the entire vehicle usually doesn't need to be re-wrapped; only that specific piece will be replaced. Benefits of a full wrap include:
  • The original paint does not accumulate chips and small scratches
  • Road dirt and chemicals stay on the film
  • Easier maintenance for the body
  • Damaged elements can be re-wrapped individually
  • The new car is protected from the first miles
  • The preserved paint can increase resale value
  • Satin appearance without repainting
We carry out PPF wrapping in Belgrade, in the Zvezdara district. We can wrap both new vehicles and those that have already been driven: either fully or just the most vulnerable parts. We will select the film option during the inspection. We will showcase the result of the full wrap on the GLS with satin film once we complete the project.

Toyota Yaris GR Sport naše klijentkinje iz Beograda. Auto je kupljen polovan, ali u odličnom stanju, i nova vlasnica je odlučila da ne čeka prve gradske ogrebotine, već je odmah zaštitila karoseriju.

Yaris je kompaktni automobil za grad, i u gradu karoserija najviše strada: uske parkinge kod prodavnica i tržnih centara, susedne automobile, nepažljivo otvorena vrata, kolica iz supermarketa, grane i kamenčiće sa ulica. Najgore je kada dobiješ udubljenje ili ogrebotinu samo zato što je komšija na parkingu otvorio vrata malo šire nego što je trebalo.

Zato je karoserija u potpunosti obložena zaštitnom poliuretanskom folijom debljine **190 mikrona**.

PPF stvara čvrst proziran sloj na laku i upija male ogrebotine, oštećenja, tragove lakih kontakata tokom parkiranja, kao i pesak i kamenčiće s puta. Najviše je potrebna zaštita vratima, krilima, branicima i ogledalima, jer su oni u stalnoj opasnosti. Dobra prozirna folija pri tome jedva da se primeti, boja, sjaj i izgled karoserije ostaju nepromenjeni.

PPF ne pretvara auto u tenk i ne može zaštititi od ozbiljnih udaraca ili dubokih udubljenja. Ali obične gradske oštećenja, koja se akumuliraju tokom nekoliko godina i čine lak istrošenim, ona uspešno drži.

Yaris je napustio studio u svom fabričkom izdanju, ali sada je njegova karoserija mnogo bolje pripremljena za svakodnevni gradski život.
src/content/works/toyota-yaris-gr-sport/.4a2e488055480f4f:
This Toyota Yaris GR Sport belongs to our client from Belgrade. The car was bought used but is in excellent condition, and the new owner decided not to wait for the first city marks and to protect the body right away.

The Yaris is a compact car designed for city driving, and in urban environments, the body often takes a beating: tight parking spaces at shops and malls, neighboring vehicles, carelessly opened doors, shopping carts, branches, and stones kicked up from the road. It's especially frustrating to get a dent or chip just because a parking neighbor swung their door a bit too wide.

That’s why we wrapped the entire body in a protective polyurethane film with a thickness of **190 microns**.

PPF provides a durable transparent layer over the paint, absorbing minor scratches, scuffs, light parking contact marks, road sand, and pebbles. This is especially crucial for doors, fenders, bumpers, and mirrors, as they are constantly at risk. A good clear film is nearly invisible, preserving the color, shine, and appearance of the car.

PPF doesn't turn the car into a tank and won't protect against serious impacts or deep dents. However, it effectively guards against common city damage that can wear down the paint over a couple of years.

The Yaris left us looking factory-fresh, but now the body is much better prepared for daily urban life.
